params.name: More than 2 parallel roads
params.tooltip: Offer up to 6 parallel roads in the road builder instead of 2 (a split highway).

params.name: Experiment: track min curve radius
params.tooltip: Overrides minCurveRadius of all track types (the limit when laying track along other track). Default keeps each type's own value (40 m for the base game's tracks).

params.name: Experiment: track min drag radius
params.tooltip: Overrides minCurveRadiusBuild of all track types (the limit when dragging freely). Default keeps each type's own value (55 m for the base game's tracks).
